manifest.author: Kody Wildfeuer
manifest.description: Generic single-file hatcher for any RAPP digital-organism twin. Loads identity from cwd auto-detect, --source REPO (raw GitHub), or --egg PATH (zip), then materializes ~/.rapp/twins/<hash>/. The global brainstem's built-in Twin agent boots/chats with it immediately.

distinct_from.@rapp/egg_hatcher: egg_hatcher routes any .egg to a handler by its manifest type; this hatcher materializes a twin workspace from a checkout, repo or egg at every scale

manifest.name: @kody-w/twin_egg_hatcher

description.description: Optional human description recorded in the twin's rappid.json.

egg.description: Path to a .egg file (zip).  Used for private/air-gapped twins.

mode.description: Where to hatch.  'twin' (default) = local workspace; 'global' = extend kernel.

name.description: Optional alias to record alongside the source's rappid.json (does not change rappid).

rappid.description: For action='rollback', the rappid of the twin to un-hatch (default: cwd auto-detect).

source.description: owner/repo or github URL (e.g. 'kody-w/heimdall').  Set GH_TOKEN for private repos.
